title: Fire Punch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On a frozen, dying Earth, Agni, who can regenerate, is left permanently burning after Doma kills his village with unquenchable flames. He pursues revenge while freed slaves worship him as a god, a cinephile films him, and the story spans millennia.
life_message: It questions whether any meaning exists, and leaves readers with a search for identity and connection rather than an answer.

content.note: Cannibalism, mass slaughter, decapitation and torture (Wikipedia; AniList Gore, Torture 83%, Cannibalism).
Post-apocalyptic horror and body horror (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy 94%, Body Horror).
Sexual violence and a quasi-incestuous relationship (Wikipedia on the relationship; AniList Rape, Incest; MangaUpdates Nudity).
Repeated suicide attempts and despair (Wikipedia; AniList Suicide 92%).
